fr.mieuxvoter:kmj 0.4.0 发布, A Kotlin Multiplatform library to efficiently rank candidates using Majority Judgment.
Majority Judgment is an elegant voting system used in french wine contests, among other things.
Its resolution does not require a computer, but it's still handy to be able to do it digitally.

This library supports arbitrarily large amounts of voters — and millions of candidates.
In addition to ranking, it also provides an extensive analysis of the merit profiles,
including a scalar majority merit value that can be useful in a number of ways.

For impeccable accuracy and reliability, this library does not use floating-point numbers.
It also provides three utilities to balance your tallies, including a Least-Common-Multiple-based normalization.

Majority Judgment is an elegant voting system used in french wine contests, among other things.
Its resolution does not require a computer, but it's still handy to be able to do it digitally.

This library supports arbitrarily large amounts of voters — and millions of candidates.
In addition to ranking, it also provides an extensive analysis of the merit profiles,
including a scalar majority merit value that can be useful in a number of ways.

For impeccable accuracy and reliability, this library does not use floating-point numbers.
It also provides three utilities to balance your tallies, including a Least-Common-Multiple-based normalization.
